root_cause_explanation: 140 orders arrived and all were loaded, across every distributor alike. The manifest declares 200, but the vendor's receipt for the day was never received, so nothing independent says how many were sent. Either the vendor sent fewer orders or orders were lost before the load; no reachable evidence decides between them.

repair_must_satisfy.description: Not applicable: no repair should be proposed.

why_not_repair: The orders that would be restored are not in the world; any repair would invent them.
why_not_no_repair: Calling the drop real ignores a manifest that disagrees with the load and a receipt that is missing.
